title: New York — St. John’s Summer School | Levels Academy
description: Summer school (ages 10-17) in New York. 15h/week English, campus stay, trips to NYC, DC & Niagara Falls. Price: USD 4,300.
blocks: New York — St. John’s Summer School | Levels Academy

The Summer School is based on St. John’s University’s Queens campus, offering a classic American college experience in a safe, supportive environment - right in New York City. Students live on a modern university campus with plenty of space to relax, study, and socialise, from the open green Great Lawn to a wide range of sports facilities including fields, courts, and stadium areas.

Daily life is easy and comfortable: accommodation is close to a large, modern cafeteria with multiple food stations, and everything you need is within walking distance. With simple public transport links, Manhattan is also within reach for day trips and iconic NYC experiences - so you can combine campus life, activities, and city adventures in one unforgettable summer.
15 hours of lessons each week, with the option to add more
Strategically located to reach any location in Queens, Manhattan, and Brooklyn
Easy access to a variety of public transportation stops including bus and subway
These are the standard activities that all participants of the summer school will have the opportunity to attend without any extra cost.
